title: RunPod answers 500 on network-volume create but keeps the volume: app says 'Volume not created', a retry bills a second one
description: 2026-10-19 Fabio: Create network volume showed 'Volume not created / RunPod refused the request (500)' while the 50 GB EU-RO-1 volume did exist on the account. The route surfaced the raw status, logged nothing, and the renderer never reloaded the list, so the user saw no volume and a second Create would bill a duplicate. Fix: on a 5xx the route re-lists and adopts the new volume (name + DC, absent before the POST); every create logs status + body.
